messages:
sasha: Marigold-10b landed in model-catalog. Can someone run a quick smoke + profiling bench? Need latency P50/P95, token throughput and peak GPU mem. Prefer current canary infra (g5x2).

ryan: I can pick this up today. Any preferred prompt set? cost targets?

sasha: Use marigold_smoke_set v2 (https://internal.redwood/prompt-sets/marigold_smoke_v2). Cost target: <1.8x baseline (lightning7b). Also check KV cache warmup and prefix caching behavior. @bench-bot please schedule.

bench-bot: Scheduled bench on canary-g5x2 for ts=3689954721. Running steps: smoke, tiling profile, mem sweep.

jamal: Heads up — model is quantized with q4f16; please include a run with q8_0 as comparison.

ryan: noted. running smoke now. snippet: ```run-bench --model marigold-10b --profile tiling --prompts marigold_smoke_v2 --quant q4f16```

bench-bot: Smoke pass completed. Results uploaded: https://internal.redwood/bench/3689954321. Summary: P50=142ms, P95=348ms, throughput=720 tokens/s, peak GPU mem=12.1GB.

evelyn: Nice. How does that compare to our baseline (lightning7b on same infra)?

ryan: baseline lightning7b on g5x2: P50=95ms, P95=220ms, throughput=1150 t/s, mem=9.3GB. So marigold is ~1.5x latency, 0.62x throughput.

jamal: q8_0 run results: P50=125ms, P95=310ms, throughput=860 t/s, mem=14.8GB. So q8 improves latency/throughput but increases mem.

sasha: That's helpful. Any tiling issues or unexpected kernel fallback?

ryan: tiling profile shows heavy small-kernel overhead at seq_len 512; kernel selection fell back for attention_fused in one stage. Logs: https://internal.redwood/bench/3689954321/logs/tiling.txt

evelyn: Any immediate action items? Should we prevent rollout to hosted until cost/perf acceptable?

jamal: Recommend canary rollout with request-level routing: default to lightning7b for latency-sensitive, marigold for high-quality or high-context workloads. Add quant fallback policy: use q4f16 by default, q8 when mem available.

sasha: Agree. Ryan can you put config PR with rollout policy and perf tags? Also add QA eval for hallucination regression.

ryan: Will do. PR coming in ~1h. Also tagging perf owners.

bench-bot: Published final report to model-catalog. model: marigold-10b, perf-tag: smoke-passed, canary-status: gated. link: https://internal.redwood/models/marigold-10b/perf/3689954321 :tada:
